method: One binary and exact same two-publication seed for local, remote retained and remote empty-retained arms. Production hydrate reconstructs authenticated remote files for the local seed. Fresh JVM/clean graph and private cache per run; fixed source/tool/environment identity; fresh tiny genrule forces publication. Three samples per arm in rotated order. Remote timed commands connect directly to the worker; the created proxy is bypassed and records no RPCs. Local warmup excluded.

publication_probe.purpose: One new key forces equivalent publication work; six original binaries remain checked.
